summary: Master HSE Management Systems with our 5-day expert-led course. Align with ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 to drive safety performance and ESG goals. Enroll today.
lede: Effective health, safety, and environmental risk management uses HSE management systems to identify hazards, assess risks, and guide workplace controls. For HSE managers, environmental officers, operations managers, and auditors, this training addresses the practical work of setting up and reviewing safety and environmental protocols. It covers hazard assessment, operational controls, and system evaluation through audits and performance dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the design, implementation, and oversight of safety and environmental protocols within industrial, corporate, or high-risk environments.
audience: Occupational Health Specialists focused on workplace wellness
modules: HSE Management Foundations and ISO Standards
Advanced Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment
Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in a safety, environmental, or operational role. Familiarity with basic workplace safety concepts is required. Prior exposure to ISO management system standards is beneficial but not mandatory.
